competencyTargets.label: Review plans and evaluate sites for environmental health permits
Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure
Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases
Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination
Manage field sample custody and field quality control
Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty
Plan and run extreme heat preparedness and response programmes
Assess human health risks from environmental exposures
Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments
Calibrate field observers and run field measurement quality assurance
Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products
Coordinate environmental response operations within incident command
Build working partnerships with communities affected by environmental decisions
Conduct participatory and community-based environmental research

mappings.pctTimeNotice: % time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.

topTasks.statement: Inspect a retail food establishment for foodborne illness risk factors, ranking violations by public-health risk and recording required corrections
Evaluate an onsite wastewater site's soils, separation distances and proposed design before issuing a construction permit
Review food establishment construction plans against code provisions for equipment, layout and plumbing before approving construction
Inspect a public swimming pool's water chemistry, circulation and safety equipment, closing the pool when an imminent health hazard exists
Collect food, water and environmental samples during an outbreak investigation following chain-of-custody and laboratory submission requirements
Identify contributing factors of a foodborne outbreak from interviews with an implicated establishment's staff and review of its records
Survey larval and adult mosquito populations at fixed and complaint sites following the vector programme's trapping protocol
Select mosquito control measures from surveillance counts and arbovirus test results against the programme's action thresholds
Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it
Testify as a fact or expert witness in an enforcement proceeding, explaining the evidence and methods behind each finding
Plan contamination-controlled field sampling for genetic detection of a target species, setting sites, timing, replicates and field blanks
